about:
I am a Data Analyst focused on solving real business problems using data. During my experience at Manoj Cargo Carriers, I worked on GC, GDM, and THP datasets to understand freight revenue, route profitability, vendor spend, and cash-flow pressure.

My core strength is end-to-end analytics: from data cleaning and transformation to dashboard development and insight communication. I have worked with SQL (MySQL), Python (Pandas), Excel, Power BI, and Tableau to build analytics workflows that help teams make better decisions.

I also collaborated with engineering teams during a Django monolith-to-microservices migration, supporting dataset validation and data consistency across services. This gave me strong cross-functional exposure to both analytics and product environments.
whatIBring: Strong SQL-driven analysis for operational and business data
Clean, reliable datasets through ETL and validation
Dashboarding and KPI reporting for leadership visibility
Insight storytelling that connects data to action

experience.role: Graduate Trainee Engineer – Data Analytics & Operations
highlights: Analyzed GC, GDM, and THP records using SQL (MySQL) to measure revenue concentration, route profitability, vendor exposure, and payment-cycle risk.
Cleaned and transformed multi-source operational datasets using Pandas and Excel, improving data reliability for revenue, delivery, and cash-flow analysis.
Developed reporting views and dashboards tracking booking volume, transport cost, customer contribution, and vendor spend, reducing manual reporting effort.
Identified high-value customers, high-cost routes, and concentrated vendor spend to support commercial and operational planning decisions.
Supported data validation during migration from a Django monolith to microservices, ensuring data consistency across multiple services.
